title: 第1440章 召唤海神法相第1439章 巨龙岛灭
lines: “既如此，那就尽快激发此阵吧，以免这些龙族精血中的灵力消散了，影响海神法相的威力。”
筱岛主有些着急地催促了一句。
“哈哈，仙子说的有理！”
鲛人族族长哈哈一笑，随即身形一跃地，便进入了那座法阵之中。
而后，只见其抬手间一挥，无数道阵诀纷纷扬扬间，便朝法阵四周落去。
那些阵诀刚一落到光滑的石面上后，很快便没入了石面上刻画的阵纹之中。
随即，整座小山似乎忽然间便出现了些许颤动。
在颤动之中，那些阵纹竟然开始微微凹陷了进去，仿佛是被人用刻刀在石头上划出了道道痕迹一般。
这时，只见鲛人族族长脸色无比郑重地道：“快，就现在！”
说话间，三族妖修之中，瞬间便走出了十多位四阶妖修，他们同时打开了储血瓶，将滚滚龙血妖族的精血，朝那法阵的凹痕中倾倒了起来！
一时间，整个巨龙岛上，浓郁的血腥气息，再度弥漫开来。
某处界面，一座不知名黑色殿宇中，炉烟袅袅。
香炉前方，不大的池塘中，无数荷花莲叶，亭亭玉立。
荷叶之下，十余尾红鲤悠闲地摆动着尾巴，自在地游来游去。
池塘中间，一头老龟则安静地趴在池塘假山之上晒着背。
就在此时，一尾黑色的鲶鱼，忽然从假山下方的洞中窜出，准确地一口吞下了一条红鲤！
“哎……老黑，这都多少年了，你这爱吃血食的毛病，还是没改……”
“就这区区凡种红鲤，能有什么味道？”
假山上的老龟伸了一下脖子，朝着黑色鲶鱼说道。
“嘿嘿……这红鲤虽然是凡种，可在主人的仙气滋润下，口感比普通的三四阶的妖兽，都要好得多呢……”
说话间，那条鲶鱼忽然从水中一跃而起，而后身形化为了一个五尺有余的干瘪老头，轻轻地落在了老龟身侧的石头上。
然而，就在干瘪老头想要继续说什么时，却见殿宇前方一处地面上，陡然间亮起了一个红色的光圈，而且不久后，光圈之中便出现了道道腥红血纹，随即又冒出了阵阵腥红的血气。
“嗯？老黑，这似乎是主人当年留在下界的显圣法阵吧？”
老龟伸长了脖子，看着那红色光圈，有些疑惑地接着道：“如果记得没错的话，这座显圣法阵，似乎有将近二十万年前，没有亮起过了，怎么现在下界之中还有蝼蚁能够布置出来？”
“嘿嘿，我记得，主人当年仙道尚未大成，靠这显圣法阵，倒是获取了不少血食呢。”
干瘪老头闻到法阵中的血腥味道后，脸上露出了极为贪婪地神色。
“呵呵，可惜了，且不说主人眼下正在闭关，即便没有闭关，以他老人家眼下的仙道修为，这些血食早已无用了……”
老龟微微一摇头，然后缩回了脖子道：“直接关闭法阵吧……”
然而，干瘪老头闻声，却一动不动，双目中的贪婪之色，却越来越浓。
老龟见状，微一迟疑，再度伸长了脖子道：“我说，你不会是想趁着主人闭关，趁机凝聚法身下界去吧？”
content_en:
"In that case, activate this formation as soon as possible, lest the spiritual power in these dragon blood essences and blood dissipate and affect the power of the Poseidon Dharma."
Master Shinojima urged a little anxiously.
"Haha, the fairy is right!"
The leader of the Sharman Clan laughed, and then jumped to the ground and entered the magic circle.
Then, he raised his hand and waved, and countless formation techniques flew around and fell towards the surroundings of the formation.
As soon as those formation formulas landed on the smooth stone surface, they quickly disappeared into the formation patterns carved on the stone surface.
Immediately, the whole hill seemed to tremble suddenly.
During the trembling, the formation patterns began to dent slightly, as if someone had used a carving knife to draw traces on the stone.
At this time, the leader of the Sharman clan said with an extremely solemn expression: "Quick, now!"
While speaking, among the three demon cultivators, more than a dozen fourth-level demon cultivators walked out in an instant. They opened the blood storage bottles at the same time, and poured the dragon blood demon clan's blood essence into the indentation of the magic circle!
For a time, the entire Dragon Island was filled with a strong smell of blood again.
…
In a certain interface, in an unknown black palace, smoke curled up from the furnace.
In front of the incense burner, in a small pond, countless lotus leaves stand gracefully.
Under the lotus leaves, more than a dozen red carp swayed their tails leisurely and swam around freely.
In the middle of the pond, an old turtle was lying quietly on the rockery of the pond, basking in the sun.
At this moment, a black catfish suddenly jumped out of the hole under the rockery and swallowed a red carp accurately!
"Hey...Old Hei, after all these years, you still haven't changed your habit of eating blood food..."
"What kind of flavor can this mere red carp have?"
The old turtle on the rockery stretched out his neck and said to the black catfish.
"Hehe... Although this red carp is a mortal species, but nourished by the master's immortal energy, its taste is much better than ordinary third- and fourth-level monsters..."
While he was talking, the catfish suddenly jumped up from the water, then transformed into a wizened old man more than five feet tall, and landed gently on the stone beside the old turtle.
However, just when the wizened old man wanted to continue saying something, he saw a red circle of light suddenly light up on the ground in front of the palace, and not long after, scarlet blood lines appeared in the circle, and then bursts of scarlet blood appeared.
"Huh? Lao Hei, this seems to be the holy manifestation circle that the master left in the lower world, right?"
The old turtle stretched his neck, looked at the red halo, and continued with some doubts: "If I remember correctly, this holy manifestation array seems to have not been lit up nearly 200,000 years ago. How come there are still ants in the lower world that can arrange it now?"
"Hehe, I remember that the master had not yet fully achieved his immortality, but he got a lot of blood food by relying on this magic circle."
After the wizened old man smelled the smell of blood in the magic circle, he showed an extremely greedy look on his face.
"Haha, it's a pity, not to mention that the master is currently in retreat. Even if he is not in retreat, with his current immortal cultivation level, these blood foods are already useless..."
The old turtle shook his head slightly, then retracted his neck and said: "Just close the magic circle..."
However, when the wizened old man heard the sound, he remained motionless, and the greed in his eyes became stronger and stronger.
Seeing this, the old turtle hesitated for a moment, stretched his neck again and said: "I said, you don't want to take advantage of the master's seclusion to gather the Dharma body in the lower realm, right?"
